notes.title: 🎉 New Update + New Release 🎮🐱
notes.notes:
Hello, word puzzlers!
We just released a new update for Mini Words with two handy features:

🕹️ Gamepad Support – You can now play using your favorite controller
☁️ Steam Cloud – Keep your progress saved across devices



We hope this makes your experience even more comfortable and enjoyable!
And while we're celebrating updates...


[hr][/hr]🎶 New DLC - Meow Moments: Music Festival 🎶


Our cozy hidden-objects game Meow Moments: Celebrating Together just got new content!
The brand-new Music Festival DLC is out now! 🎉

Explore a vibrant outdoor event with feline friends, colorful music stages (pop, rock, folk, electronic), a Ferris wheel, camping zones, and more. Featuring artwork by Katia Numakura and music by Tatyana Jacques, it’s a celebration of music and togetherness!



🐾 Try the base game for free and check out the new DLC:

notes.title: Pathfinders: Memories - Full version released!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37614392/f7349379270a52ec7d8c29a72d348bb8442a7fd1.jpg

Pathfinders: Memories has just been released in Full Version!

Use your memory to help Pathfinders travel through time visiting ancient human civilizations and search for relics. The path to success is full of entrapments, obstacles, and enemies. Memorize them and draw the safe path for our heroes.

The final version adds these features:

- The final civilization - England in Industrial Revolution - is available, completing the total of six civilizations - Ancient Rome, Ancient Egypt, the Vikings, Mali Empire, the Arabs, and Industial England.

- The museum of the human civilizations - the gallery showcasing the relics found in each civilization can be visited at any time. Find all of them to complete the museum!

Play it now!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1294780/Pathfinders_Memories/


We thank everyone who supported us during Early Access by playing the game.

We are a small game studio focused on creating games that are simple but provide a pleasant experience to the player, mostly solving puzzles (either logic, word, jigsaw) in a relaxing environment, without timers or rush.

Follow our studio page on Steam to keep up-to-date with our releases!
https://store.steampowered.com/developer/menssana

notes.title: Update - Brand new levels for Mini Words!
notes.notes:
We are updating Mini Words with brand new extra levels! 

This expansion is free to everyone who has purchased it. After downloading the update, they will be unlocked to everyone who completes the previous available levels - A to P. 

All new levels (from Q to Z) contain a subset of the 721 previously discovered words - the most used words in English conversation.

The update also contains some visual adjustments and spelling reviews, as well as an option to restore game progress that could have been reset for some players (in Options menu).

This is to thank you all who have played and enjoyed Mini Words!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35968398/c935a5df860d3c29cd838a145c41f1460e58ea56.png

And also to inform you about our game released a few weeks ago! 
That's "Mini Words: Top Movies", where you will test your knowledge about the highest-grossing films of all time.
ːsteamhappyː

Play "Mini Words: Top Movies" here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1276040/Mini_Words_Top_Movies/
